description: This file defines classes and methods related to managing and interfacing with CUDA streams and events within the PyTorch framework. It provides wrappers for CUDA streams and events, including external stream support and synchronization mechanisms.

classes.name: Stream
classes.description: Wrapper around a CUDA stream, supporting stream operations like wait, record, synchronize, and comparison.

classes.name: ExternalStream
classes.description: Wrapper around an externally allocated CUDA stream, used for interoperability with other libraries without managing stream lifecycle.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Wrapper around a CUDA event for synchronization, timing, and inter-process communication.

methods.name: Stream.__new__
methods.description: Creates a new Stream instance, wrapping a CUDA stream and handling device context and priority.

methods.name: Stream.wait_event
methods.description: Makes the stream wait for a CUDA event.

methods.name: Stream.wait_stream
methods.description: Synchronizes the current stream with another stream.

methods.name: Stream.record_event
methods.description: Records an event in the stream, optionally creating a new event.

methods.name: Stream.query
methods.description: Checks if all work in the stream has completed.

methods.name: Stream.synchronize
methods.description: Waits until all kernels in the stream have finished.

methods.name: Stream._as_parameter_
methods.description: Returns the CUDA stream as a ctypes pointer for interoperability.

methods.name: Stream.__eq__
methods.description: Checks equivalence of two Stream objects.

methods.name: Stream.__hash__
methods.description: Provides a hash for the stream object.

methods.name: Stream.__repr__
methods.description: String representation of the stream object.

methods.name: Stream.__cuda_stream__
methods.description: Implements the CUDA stream protocol, returning version and handle.

methods.name: ExternalStream.__new__
methods.description: Creates an ExternalStream wrapping an externally allocated CUDA stream.

methods.name: Event.__new__
methods.description: Creates a new Event with specified properties like timing, blocking, etc.

methods.name: Event.from_ipc_handle
methods.description: Reconstructs an event from an IPC handle on a specified device.

methods.name: Event.record
methods.description: Records the event in a specified stream or current stream by default.

methods.name: Event.wait
methods.description: Makes a stream wait for the event to complete.

methods.name: Event.query
methods.description: Checks if the event has completed.

methods.name: Event.elapsed_time
methods.description: Returns milliseconds elapsed between this event and another event.

methods.name: Event.synchronize
methods.description: Waits for the event to complete.

methods.name: Event.ipc_handle
methods.description: Returns an IPC handle for the event.

methods.name: Event._as_parameter_
methods.description: Returns the CUDA event as a ctypes pointer.

methods.name: Event.__repr__
methods.description: String representation of the event, showing its handle.
